description: This file implements the CloudStore class, including initialization, deinitialization, and configuration management for a cloud storage plugin within the WPEFramework. It manages external dependencies, service registration, and configuration setup.

classes.name: CloudStore
classes.description: Main class implementing cloud storage plugin functionalities, including initialization, cleanup, and configuration management.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the CloudStore plugin, sets up configuration, security tokens, and registers necessary services.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up resources, unregisters services, and releases references during shutdown.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns a string with plugin information; currently returns an empty string.
